exposure: Tympanostomy tube-delivered monoclonal antibodies (anti-rsPilA and anti-tip-chimer)
outcome: Changes in nasopharyngeal and fecal microbiomes
cohort: Nine cohorts of healthy chinchillas (n=3 per cohort).
finding: Broad-spectrum antibiotics, regardless of delivery route (oral or tympanostomy tube), caused significant disruption to the nasopharyngeal and fecal microbiomes of chinchillas, while biofilm-targeting antibodies did not.
